title: Casting Calls - Court Actors for Justice Central Court Shows
text:
Justice Central court Shows Announce Open‌ Casting Call for Actors Published: October 26, 2023 | By: Julia​ Evans, World Today News
Actors seeking on-camera experience have an ​chance to participate in upcoming shoots for the Justice Central Court Shows. ⁤ Casting ⁢is currently underway for ⁢a variety of roles, with ‍shoots scheduled to begin next week. Interested individuals can find more information at http://justicecentral.tv/ .
Who They’re Looking for The production⁢ is seeking individuals⁣ of all types and ages 18 and older. They are also specifically looking for​ minors to fill roles in some upcoming segments. This represents a valuable opportunity ‌for actors to gain important camera time,collaborate with experienced producers,and build ⁣their ​acting reels.
Adult talent will be required to participate in a 10-minute Zoom ⁣audition with ​producers. This audition process is designed to help ‌place⁤ actors ‍in roles best suited to⁣ their abilities. Minors will not be required to ⁢audition; selection for minor roles will‍ be based on‍ submitted photographs.
Zoom auditions are being held three ⁣times daily,⁣ offering flexibility for actors to schedule a convenient time. Actors simply need to‌ select​ a date and ‍time slot that works with their availability.
Vital Eligibility Restrictions Please note that individuals who have previously appeared as a plaintiff, defendant, or witness ‍on any of the following Entertainment Studios Court Shows are not eligible to ‌participate:
America’s Court with Judge Ross Justice for All ​with Judge Cristina Perez Justice with Judge Mablean Supreme Justice with Judge Karen The⁤ Verdict with Judge Hatchett We The People with ⁢Judge Lauren Lake We the People with Gloria Allred Important Note: Unfortunately, due⁤ to production‍ requirements, this casting call is ⁣unable to consider‌ applicants with any discernible foreign accent.
If you meet the eligibility requirements ⁢and are interested in participating,please submit your ​information. the production​ team will follow up with detailed instructions.
